metadata.description: Zero-auth free local MCP plugins for coding agents (Cursor marketplace). Paid Pro is a separate product outside this repo.

plugins.name: dev-microtools
plugins.description: Changelog briefs, semver risk, JWT inspect, cron explain, OpenAPI diff, stack parse, env key diff.

plugins.name: log-fingerprint
plugins.description: Fingerprint and cluster noisy logs, detect spikes, and brief error budgets — local, zero-auth.

plugins.name: env-contract
plugins.description: Infer env contracts, check drift, render safe .env.example, and overlap-check docker-compose env.

plugins.name: sql-migration-guard
plugins.description: Heuristic SQL migration risk scanning, order checks, rollback sketches, and lock notes — local, zero-auth.

plugins.name: har-diff
plugins.description: Compare HTTP Archive (HAR) captures for status/timing/size regressions, list failing requests, scan cookie names/flags — local, zero-auth.

plugins.name: release-notes-forge
plugins.description: Turn conventional commits into release notes, flag breakings, suggest semver — local, zero-auth, free.

plugins.name: json-schema-fixtures
plugins.description: Validate JSON against schemas, generate fixtures, diff schemas — local, zero-auth, free.

plugins.name: git-archaeology
plugins.description: Blame digests, churn hotspots, why-here briefs, and diff risk heuristics — local, zero-auth, free.

plugins.name: dockerfile-lint-lite
plugins.description: Heuristic Dockerfile and compose risk scans — local, zero-auth, free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: openapi-mock-lite
plugins.description: Load OpenAPI specs, mock responses, find coverage gaps, heuristic security scan — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: csv-schema-guard
plugins.description: Infer/validate CSV schemas, header diffs, heuristic PII column flags — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: regex-lab
plugins.description: Test, explain, preview replace, and lint regexes — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: semver-range-lab
plugins.description: Semver range satisfy/intersect/expand + dependency range risk — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: commit-msg-guard
plugins.description: Conventional commit parse/lint, breaking-change and trailer checks — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: http-status-atlas
plugins.description: HTTP status explain/classify, retry advice, cache hints — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: yaml-path-query
plugins.description: YAML parse/get/key-diff and secret redaction — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: markdown-toc-lint
plugins.description: Markdown TOC generate/check, heading lint, link scan — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: json-pointer-lab
plugins.description: JSON Pointer get/set preview, JSON Patch preview, flatten — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: base64-url-lab
plugins.description: Base64/URL encode-decode and JWT part decode (no verify) — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: uuid-ulid-lab
plugins.description: UUID parse/generate, ULID generate, id detect — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: duration-parse
plugins.description: Parse/format durations, deadlines from now, compare — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: slugify-case
plugins.description: Slugify, case convert/detect, filename sanitize — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: hash-lab
plugins.description: SHA/MD5 hash, compare digests, checksum text, HMAC-SHA256 — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: diff-unified-stats
plugins.description: Unified diff stats, file list, hunk counts, risk flags — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: querystring-lab
plugins.description: Query string parse/stringify/merge/diff — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: mime-ext-lab
plugins.description: Extension↔MIME mapping and Content-Type header parse — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: ini-toml-lite
plugins.description: INI/TOML-lite parse, config key diff, secret redact — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: port-service-lab
plugins.description: Common port↔service lookup, range class, listen hints — free marketplace funnel (no scanning).

plugins.name: ip-cidr-lab
plugins.description: Parse IPs, CIDR contain/explain, private-range checks — free marketplace funnel.

plugins.name: cron-explain
plugins.description: Parse/validate 5-field cron, next fire times, expr diffs — free marketplace funnel.
